correctness.rationale: The proof rewrites the sample mean and sample range as linear combinations of two nested empirical-cut variables. Each of the four required cut covariances is evaluated exactly, yielding one quadratic in the support gap. Monotonicity of phi_n and a one-positive-root argument give the exhaustive sign classification. Exact rational enumeration independently checks the identities for small sample sizes.

value.rationale: The sample mean and sample range are a classical location--dispersion pair. The theorem gives a complete, exact dependence-sign classification in the smallest nontrivial discrete population, including support-invariant sign regimes and a unique uncorrelated support. This sharply separates zero covariance from the much stronger normal-characterizing independence property.
